svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flat plate 160 mm long, 90 mm wide at the back, 474 mm wide at the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front where it meets the bulkhead and the two rails.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hole 34.5 mm, 100 mm from the back edge: the lower headset cup spigot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back part: a slot (a side plate's tab) and a 9 mm bolt hole each side,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 33 mm from the centre line. Front edge: 4 tabs and 3 T-slots into the bulkhead.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: T-slot: 9 mm wide, 23 deep, with a 13.6 x 8.4 mm window 10 mm in for the nut.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: it lies flat under the side plates' level bottom edges and under

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the head tube; the lower cup's flange holds it up against the tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the hole lines up with the upper yoke's hole (plumb line).
